## NOSOCOMIAL SINUSITIS
Nasogastric tubes increase the risk of bacterial sinus infection associated with
Staphylococcus aureus, streptococcus, and gram-negative bacilli, including
Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Aspirate sinuses for gram stain and culture to direct
antimicrobial therapy. Adequate sinus drainage is vital to treatment.
